docs.title: Kotlin Popcorn Game
docs.text: This is a simple popcorn game using Kotlin language. Catch the falling popcorn pieces to the bucket before the popcorn reaches the floor.

docs.title: Getting Started
docs.text:
1. Clone the repository.
  2. Compile and run:
kotlinc main.kt -include-runtime -d popcorn-game.jar
java -jar popcorn-game.jar

Or run: kotlin main.kt
